_comment: Queries on `events` that filter ONE unpublish switch and not the other, on purpose.
Read by scripts/check-event-unpublish-filters.mjs; see its header for the rule.
Every entry here is a job that OWNS one switch and therefore has to see rows the
other one hides. A reader surface never belongs in this file.
Keyed by file plus the switch it has, not by line, so moving a query does not break
the check - and a NEW asymmetric query in the same file under the same switch is not
silently covered, because the check also fails on an entry that matches nothing.

allowed.reason: This IS the hide job. Its dry-run counts select rows that are not yet hidden; filtering archived_at would hide part of its own work list from the operator reading the count.

This IS the archive sweep. Its work list is past events with archived_at IS NULL, and a moderator-hidden past event still needs archiving - filtering is_hidden would leave those un-archived forever. The link-health sample below it is internal maintenance, not a reader surface.
The deployed copy of link-content-monitor.ts; same reason, and the pair must stay identical (scripts/check-agent-pair-drift.mjs).
